verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms llms.txt is served (HTTP 200 at airwallex.com/llms.txt), and the docs also publish /docs/llms.txt with per-page .md versions. Airwallex adds a dedicated 'Instructions for AI agents' page written for machine consumption, plus an unauthenticated Docs MCP that agents can query. Missing for 10: the root /docs.md markdown index returns 404, and there is no independent or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
